hero.title: National Training
hero.subtitle: Facility & Platforms
hero.desc: India's premier strength destination designed specifically for Olympic-grade IPF powerlifting, elite hypertrophy preparation, and advanced athlete recovery.

highlights.title: 8 Competition Platforms
highlights.subtitle: Built to IPF Standards
highlights.desc: 4m x 4m heavy-duty hardwood lifting platforms with vibration-absorbing high-density rubber drop zones, eliminating rebound deflection.

highlights.title: Eleiko & Rogue Combo Racks
highlights.subtitle: Calibrated Competition Hardware
highlights.desc: Every platform features official IPF-approved combo racks with tilt-in uprights and precision lever jacks for instant bench and squat height changes.

highlights.title: 4,000+ KG Calibrated Steel
highlights.subtitle: Verified within ±10g Tolerance
highlights.desc: Full sets of competition-colored calibrated steel discs (25kg Red, 20kg Blue, 15kg Yellow, 10kg Green, change plates down to 0.25kg).

highlights.title: Specialty Bar Arsenal
highlights.subtitle: Targeted Strength Development
highlights.desc: Safety Squat Bars (SSB), Buffalo Bars, Cambered Squat Bars, Swiss Multi-Grip Bars, Trap Bars, and competition deadlift bars.

highlights.title: Sports Science & Recovery Suite
highlights.subtitle: Rapid Muscle Restoration
highlights.desc: Cold plunge tub at 3°C, pneumatic leg compression boots, percussion massage therapy, and infrared recovery conditioning.

highlights.title: Head Coaches On Deck
highlights.subtitle: Akash & Tanvi Daily Presence
highlights.desc: Hands-on bar path analysis, real-time command practice, and customized warm-up supervision for visiting lifters and national squad members.

passes.name: Single Day Pass
passes.desc: Ideal for traveling lifters, form check visits, or heavy test day simulation.
passes.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like to book a Single Day Training Pass at the National Facility.

passes.name: Monthly Athlete Pass
passes.desc: Unlimited monthly platform access for competitive athletes and dedicated lifters.
features: Dedicated chalk, platform & specialty bar access
Bi-weekly technique review with Coach Akash
passes.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like to enroll for the Monthly Athlete Training Pass at the facility.

passes.name: Competition Camp / Team Pass
passes.desc: Complete private platform booking for gym teams, state squads, or meet peaking squads.
features: Full electronic referee 3-light mock meet simulation
Attempt selection guidance with Coaches Akash & Tanvi
passes.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, our team would like to book a Competition Peaking Camp at the facility.

cta.title: Want to Tour the Facility in Person?
cta.desc: Meet Coaches Akash & Tanvi at the platform lab for an in-person orientation, equipment trial, and discussion of your competition goals.
cta.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like to schedule an in-person visit and platform trial at the National Facility.
